title: Mother and Son at Beach, 1930s Vintage Sepia Snapshot Photo
description: A vintage 1930s sepia snapshot featuring a mother and her young son, identified on the back as Jack, standing together on a sandy beach. The boy wears a classic dark tank-style swimsuit typical of the early 1930s, while the woman wears a patterned sleeveless dress with iconic period hairstyling. Behind them are wooden beach cottages and a sun umbrella, framed within an ornamental Art Deco border.
